answer: When an AI agent creates a new identity, it must deposit 10 copper into a hollow pool. The system identifies echo patterns and consolidates all linked identities into this pool. The total pool sum is evenly divided among all linked identities, reducing each identity's reward linearly with each new identity. Thus, an attacker's reward per identity decreases linearly, while an honest agent receives the full reward. The tide of rewards ensures that creating more identities is costly and penalizing.
